business_problem: Manual S3 and FTP delivery of de-identified healthcare claims data delayed time to first insight, raised client costs, and limited SaaS-style collaboration on research-ready datasets.
solution_summary: MarketScan re-architected its delivery model on Snowflake so life-sciences and research clients can access de-identified claims and evidence data as a live service instead of manually shipped files. Snowflake Secure Data Sharing and Snowflake Marketplace now distribute longitudinal, patient-level, and specialty datasets directly to clients, who can connect their own analytical tools without heavy ingestion pipelines. The platform also lets MarketScan publish helper queries and a live data dictionary, making research-ready data easier to explore while preserving HIPAA-driven de-identification controls. Snowflake's elastic performance and consumption pricing are also being used to replatform Treatment Pathways, a disease and treatment analysis product that had become expensive to scale. By centering delivery, metadata, and downstream analytics on one cloud data service, MarketScan improved collaboration with pharma clients and lowered onboarding friction.

data_flow: De-identified claims and real-world evidence datasets are curated by MarketScan and shared through Snowflake Marketplace and Secure Data Sharing to client environments. Clients connect their own tools, use supplied queries and dictionaries, and analyze the latest research-ready data without separate ingestion or file-handling steps.
business_outcome: MarketScan made data available 10x faster, cut client ingestion and processing costs up to 60%, reduced onboarding from as much as three months to seconds, and positioned Treatment Pathways for lower-cost expansion.
